pl-l4d1c6-d1e115.summary: Turns to the difference between the old and new sacraments, calling sacraments in the old sense what signified sacred things, like sacrifices and offerings.

pl-l4d1c6-d1e118.summary: Gives Augustine's brief statement of the difference: the old only promised and signified; the new give salvation.
claims: The old sacraments promised and signified; the new give salvation.

pl-l4d1c6.summary: Turns to the difference between the old and new sacraments, calling sacraments in the old sense the sacrifices, offerings, and the like that signified sacred things. Augustine states it briefly: the old only promised and signified; the new give salvation.
claims: The old sacraments only promised and signified; the new give salvation.
